title: Small-site strict direct-image projection and unit normalization
statement: Let U,V be small sites and f:Sh(U)→Sh(V) a geometric morphism with its constant-module inverse-image lift [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. Let A be a commutative ring with CompleteCoefficientDatum d [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum], put B=ULift(A) in the site universe and J the image of d.ideal under the canonical ring equivalence. For every derived J-complete K on U with B coefficients, the specified strict counit-tensor projection h_f: R_V(Rf_*K)→R^tower f_* R_U(K) is invertible, and eta_(Rf_*K) followed by Rlim(h_f) equals Rf_*(eta_K) followed by the specified adjunction-conjugate directLimitIso at R_U(K). The equality holds in the derived strict-diagram formulation; no equality is inferred from faithfulness of derived evaluations.

source.place: Tags 099M and 099N(3),(4); sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0B56, 0941 and 0A07; strict-diagram refinement of fix-lem-exchanges Step 5.

proof.text: Transport quotients, their transition maps, and finite perfect resolutions through ULift.ringEquiv. The canonical quotient isomorphism identifies each B/J^(n+1) with ULift(A/I^(n+1)). Evaluation of the strict counit-tensor mate is the finite perfect-coefficient projection map, hence invertible. Derived strict-tower cohomology is levelwise, so the whole mate is invertible.

source.place: Tags 099M and 099N(3),(4); sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0B56, 0941 and 0A07; strict-diagram refinement of fix-lem-exchanges Step 5.

proof.text: Use the identity-component constant-tower/pullback comparison. Its conjugate through the prescribed constant/limit and pullback/pushforward adjunctions is directLimitIso. Uniqueness of the right-derived comparison identifies this with the normalized direct-image/derived-limit map, including its constant-tower normalization.

source.place: Tags 099M and 099N(3),(4); sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0B56, 0941 and 0A07; strict-diagram refinement of fix-lem-exchanges Step 5.

proof.text: The ordinary quotient augmentation commutes with constant pullback and tensor balancing. Pass to the universal derived quotient presentation and transpose: h i = towerPush(i) chi. Apply the derived limit, the constant-tower normalization, and naturality of directLimitIso to obtain eta_(Rf_*K) Rlim(h)=Rf_*(eta_K) b. This is normalized augmentation transport on the small sites; it uses no uniform bounds.

lean.statement:
theorem smallSiteDirectImageReconstruction
    {V U : Site.{t + 1}} (f : Morphism V U)
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CompleteCoefficientDatum A)
    (K : U.derived (ULift.{t + 1, t} A))
    (hK : U.IsComplete _ (d.ideal.map ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom) K) :
    let I := d.ideal.map ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom
    IsIso (f.towerProjection (ULift.{t + 1, t} A) I K) ∧
      (V.unit _ I).app ((f.push _).obj K) ≫
          (V.rlim _).map (f.towerProjection _ I K) =
        (f.push _).map ((U.unit _ I).app K) ≫
          (f.directLimitIso _).hom.app ((U.reduction _ I).obj K)
